store.summary: Device-first image capture, gallery, and generation app for CardputerZero
store.description: DaliCam is a device-first CardputerZero app for capturing photos, uploading test images, browsing galleries, and generating new images with Gemini and OpenAI image models. It includes an on-device prompt workflow, a browser-based WebUI on port 8080, remote capture, day-grouped galleries, per-image management tools, and a custom preset workflow for testing and everyday use.
